column1: # In the West, medical care prices rose 36% from 2016 to 2025, against 38% for all consumer prices.

# Source: BLS Consumer Price Index, West region (CPI-U, annual averages). It measures price changes, not total spending. 2025 CPI annual average uses 11 of 12 months: BLS collected no October 2025 data (lapse in appropriations).
